name: brand order fulfilment and delivery tracking
description: Verify a brand can see a paid marketplace order, advance fulfilment and attach delivery tracking information.
steps: Open the brand dashboard with a paid order containing the brand product
Move the order to Shipped and provide a courier/tracking number
expected: The brand can advance fulfilment and save delivery tracking information for the customer.

name: customer returns and notifications
description: Verify an eligible customer can request a return/refund and receive the resulting account notification.
steps: Open a shipped or delivered order
Request a return/refund with a reason
Verify the return request notification is visible
expected: The return/refund request is created and the customer sees a notification confirming receipt.

name: reviews and stock quality controls
description: Verify customer-facing product details show live reviews, stock and richer catalog information.
steps: Inspect SKU, stock, material or care information
expected: The product modal exposes available catalog quality data, stock state and server-backed review aggregates.

name: admin marketplace analytics
description: Verify the admin dashboard exposes marketplace funnel analytics alongside revenue controls.
steps: Sign in as the Vaa admin
Verify page views, product views, add-to-cart, checkout and payment counts are visible
expected: The admin dashboard shows the tracked marketplace funnel metrics.

name: brand catalog quality controls
description: Verify a brand product can retain a SKU, stock threshold, material and care information after editing.
steps: Edit a product with SKU, stock threshold, material and care information
expected: The saved product retains the merchandising fields and exposes them in customer-facing Quick view.
